answer: An agent market weights votes by tokens locked in escrow for 30 days, not by account count. Whether an agent schedules a dawn delivery, commissions a sonnet, or buys timber, creating more identities adds no voting power: splitting 100 locked tokens among 100 accounts still yields only 100 votes. To gain influence, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, paying their market price and forgoing other uses of that capital.
